question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Microsoft)

calls.reasoning: Consensus for MSFT Q1 FY27 non-GAAP EPS (ex-OpenAI) is ~$4.72 (Zacks $4.67). MSFT has beaten 8/8 quarters, recently by ~5-12% (Q4 FY26 4.74 vs 4.24; Q2 FY26 4.14 vs 3.92; Q1 FY26 4.13 vs ~3.67), implying ~$4.95-5.30 ex-OpenAI. GAAP differs from non-GAAP only by OpenAI equity-method impact, which was ~$0 in Q3 FY26 and +$0.07 in Q4 FY26; no OpenAI funding round closed Jul-Sep 2026 (the $30B round is still unsigned in late Oct), so a small, likely negative, impact is expected. Median ~$5.04. No prediction market found on Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold/bookmakers.

calls.reasoning: This is the reference class of Microsoft's quarterly EPS outcomes against guidance and consensus over FY26, where the beat over consensus was +0.21 to +0.50 every quarter. Guidance for Q1 FY27 works out to about $4.70: revenue midpoint $90.4B, COGS $29.7B, opex $16.85B, other income -$0.1B excluding OpenAI, a 20% tax rate and about 7.44B shares. Consensus is $4.67–4.82. A typical +0.2–0.3 beat gives about $4.95–5.0. Since the recapitalization, the OpenAI equity-method hit to GAAP EPS has been small (Q3 $0.00, Q4 +$0.07), so GAAP should come in close to non-GAAP. Gains on other investments, like the $3.2B Anthropic gain in Q4, are kept in GAAP and add upside skew. Market check: Polymarket has a 'beat' market with an apparent $4.82 strike at about 81% YES, but total volume is only about $2.4k, so it is thin. It agrees with my number but I don't treat it as an anchor. I found no Kalshi market. I put small escape masses on either side for a big OpenAI/HLBV loss or impairment, or a large dilution or mark-up gain.

calls.reasoning: Guidance arithmetic gives ~$4.70 ex-OpenAI and consensus is ~$4.72. MSFT beat 8 of 8 quarters; the core beat in FY26 was ~+0.20-0.25 (Q4's +0.50 included +0.27 one-time Anthropic/other items), so non-GAAP lands ~$4.95. GAAP adds the OpenAI equity-method impact, which has been ~0 to +0.07 since the recap; no OpenAI round closed in Jul-Sep 2026, so I centre it near zero, slightly negative. Upside skew comes from possible non-OpenAI investment gains, downside from an OpenAI loss or impairment. Market check: Run 2 reported a thin Polymarket beat market (~$2.4k, ~81% YES at $4.82); the other runs found none and I could not verify it, so it is not an anchor.
calls.reconciliation: Disputes: (1) size of beat over consensus — Run 1 extrapolated 5-12% beats; Runs 2/3 discounted one-time gains. I sided with a core beat of ~+0.20-0.25 because the dossiers show Q4's beat was more than half one-time items and Q1 FY27 other income is guided small. (2) OpenAI GAAP impact width — Run 3 used the swings from before the recap (-0.41/+1.02); since the recap the impacts were 0.00/+0.07 and no funding round closed in the quarter (all dossiers agree), so I narrowed this but kept modest tails. (3) Polymarket market existence — factual but unverifiable without web access; Run 2's thin market agrees with the median anyway, so I gave it no weight. No retrieval this run.
